questions.question: Describe the change in colour that is observed when bromine water is added to 1‑butene and explain the reason for this observation.
Outline the mechanism for the electrophilic addition of HBr to 2‑methyl‑1‑propene, indicating the major product formed.
Calculate the percentage yield of 1‑bromobutane if 4.00 g of 2‑butene (MW 56.1 g mol‑1) reacts with excess HBr (MW 80.9 g mol‑1) to give 3.20 g of product (MW 102.9 g mol‑1).
Explain why the addition of HBr to 1‑hexene gives a mixture of two alkyl bromides and identify which product is the major one.
Draw the repeating unit of poly(2‑butene) and state whether the polymer is likely to be crystalline or amorphous.
